subtitle: The Feeding Trail
briefing: Merek’s patrol holds the pasture beside the feeding woods. Sedge’s den will open the migration trail if Ash-Muzzle removes the occupiers. The humans are cutting the two stands beside their village; taking it back will stop them.

intro.text: Our packs will not follow another keeper into Yara’s feud. Those riders came for her.
They are eating your winter grass and cutting my hunting cover. Their feud has already reached us.
Then drive this patrol out. I will open the migration trail and speak for you at Old Root.
Done. We clear the patrol, not your dens. And if we can take their village, those cut stands will grow again.
Hold the pasture. The chief wants a clear road before he brings the rest.

victory.text: The pasture is clear. Will your packs hear me now?

dialogue.text: You kept the fighting away from our young. The trail is open; I will bring my shield to Old Root.

alternative.text: Sedge paid for this trail with his life. I will carry his pledge to Old Root.

victory.speaker: Pack runner
victory.text: Merek is gathering at the valley mouth. He says he will clear a road all the way to Yara’s grove.
Then the scattered packs cannot stay scattered. Old Root first; we will need the thorncallers there.

debrief.text: The patrol is gone, and the pasture’s bordering woods stand again. The open migration trail brings Ash-Muzzle and Sedge’s pledge toward Old Root.
The patrol is gone and the migration trail is open. The cut edge of the pasture remains exposed; Ash-Muzzle takes Sedge’s pledge toward Old Root.
The patrol broke before its cutters opened the woods. Ash-Muzzle takes Sedge’s pledge along the newly opened migration trail toward Old Root.
